thread:
marta: quick alert: premerge SAST job failed for PR #6132. Failure reason in logs: `kms:AccessDenied` when calling `projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeys/repo-signer:asymmetricSign`.
kevin: saw it too. We shipped a conditional IAM change for the `ci-service` account yesterday to test limited-time grants. Looks like the window closed early.
sophia: is the gate configured to fail-open or fail-closed on attestation errors? I want to understand blast radius.
kevin: current behavior = fail-closed (block merge). We discussed fail-open with a `pending-attestation` label but never merged the change.
marta: blocking merges overnight is rough for PLG flows. Proposal: add a safe failover path that: 1) when KMS returns AccessDenied, CI attaches an evidence stub (fields: original_sha, attempted_key_id, kms_error=AccessDenied), 2) labels PR `attestation:pending`, 3) notifies `sec-oncall` and `infra-oncall`, 4) prevents auto-merge but allows manual approve-forced merges with keystore-owner signoff.
sec-bot: [automated] SAST gate `sast-sign` failed for PR #6132. Job id: sast-2026-03-21-2330. See https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/sast-2026-03-21-2330.
sophia: long-term we need two things: an aux signing key with read-only narrower permissions and a clear provenance chain, and a periodic smoke-check that warns before conditional grants expire.
kevin: aux key is doable but must be opt-in and require keystore owner approval to use (no auto-fallback). Also we must log `signer_key_id` used for any re-sign/backfill operations.
marta: backfill workflow sketch: - backfill job fetches PR evidence stubs where `kms_error` exists, - on primary key available, perform re-sign, update evidence API with fields `re_sign_key_id`, `re_sign_time`, `original_attempt_kms_status`, - attach audit log snippet from KMS.
sophia: add guardrails: forbid automated aux-key signing unless a PR-specific keystore-approval label is present and recorded in audit.
kevin: CI change list I can pick up: 1) capture full KMS error payload into evidence metadata, 2) add labels `attestation:pending` and `evidence:needs-backfill`, 3) create backfill-ticket via API `POST /incidents/create-backfill` with template.
infra-oncall: paging guidance: sec-oncall M-F 9-5 primary for attestation keystore issues, infra-oncall nights/weekends. Escalation after 15m if no ack.
marta: also add a Grafana metric `ci.kms.errors.access_denied` and an alert that fires at >5/min sustained for 10m. We need to detect mass regressions fast.
kevin: I'll open two PRs: CI change (labels + metadata + metric emit) and runbook (backfill, approval process, smoke-check cron). Assigning to @sophia for runbook review.
sophia: will review. For the smoke-check: script should call signer: `gcloud kms asymmetric-sign --key=projects/.../repo-signer --data=smoke-check` and verify 200, then create `ops-alert` ticket if expiry < 24h.
marta: thanks. One more: ensure any re-sign operation records the KMS principal that performed the signing and a link to the incident/backfill ticket for provenance.
ci-bot: @channel PR #6132 labeled: attestation:pending, evidence:needs-backfill. Notifying @sec-oncall @infra-oncall.
sec-bot: [automated] Incident INC-2026-03-21-KMS-Attest created by CI. Follow runbook: https://runbooks.internal/keystore-attestation-fallback
marta: filing a quick follow-up to add the emergency aux-key approval flow to the runbook (manual use only). Will post PR links when ready.
